watches.name: The Cincinnatus GMT Black -Reserve
watches.description: The Cincinnatus GMT is a rugged watch designed for travel. The watch features a 12 hour dial with hours, minutes, seconds, and the date plus the addition of a 24 hour hand and rotating bezel. For travelers: When traveling the 24 hour hand can be set at your home time and the hour hand can easily be adjusted to your local time without disturbing the hours, minutes, or home time making it easy to keep track of two different time zones. For international business: If the 24 hour hand is set to Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) or UTC the bezel can be easily adjusted to see what time it is anywhere in the world. All you need to know is the timezone in the format +/-GMT For everyday: The rotating bezel has 48 positions so it can be used as a rough timer. When timing seconds each click is 1.25 seconds. When timing minutes, each click is 75 seconds. Just line up the triangle on the bezel with the seconds hand or minute hand to start your timer. Each arrow or number on the bezel represents 2.5 seconds or minutes. Assembled, tested, and regulated in Cincinnati, Ohio. The Watchmaker tests each watch for the 10 ATM water resistance and regulates the movement in 5 positions. A Quality Assurance Certificate is included with each piece, signed by the watchmaker, confirming the pressure test and the movement's accuracy. Featuring the Japanese Made Miyota 9075 Movement We chose the Miyota 9075 because it is reliable, affordable, and provides a "true" GMT function with quick set hour. Warranty Two-year warranty. watches.name: Union Terminal Limited Edition 10 Year
watches.description: Union Terminal Mechanical Cincinnati Watch Company was founded 10 years ago, and the very first watch we launched was a hand-wound mechanical version modeled after the clock on the front of Cincinnati's Union Terminal. To commemorate 10 years since our company's founding, we released a limited-edition version of the Union Terminal watch featuring a unique dial and hands in watchmaker's blue. The watch has a Swiss Made Sellita SW210 Elabore Grade movement and sapphire crystal. Each watch is individually numbered and features a special engraving on the case back showcasing the two bas-relief carvings from the outside of the Union Terminal depicting Mercury and Athena. Assembled and regulated by our in-house watchmaker Jordan Ficklin. A Union Terminal Partnership Created in partnership with the Cincinnati Museum Center, this watch is inspired by the iconic clock on the outside of Cincinnati's Union Terminal. This is the only watch we make that doesn't have our brand name on the dial. This iconic look says Cincinnati without having to put it on the dial. A portion of every sale directly benefits the Cincinnati Museum Center at Union Terminal. watches.name: Ladies Guild Shimmering Purple

The Guild honors the Guild of watchmakers who once resided in Time Hill, the former headquarters of the Gruen Watch Company. Time Hill is located in Walnut Hills Cincinnati, OH, and is now the home to Lighthouse Youth & Family Services. A portion of every sale directly benefits the Lighthouse Youth & Family Services. The watch is part of our Cincinnati Recycled collection and features a never-used vintage watch case made in Switzerland circa 1960. These cases were recovered new old stock, still in their original wrapping, but due to their age and handling over the past 50 years, they may have some slight imperfections and are not water resistant. Although the cases are vintage, the watch features a brand-new dial, hands, Swiss-made movement, and bracelet. As always, the watch is designed and assembled in Cincinnati, Ohio. The stainless steel bracelet features quick-release spring bars, allowing for easy removal without the need for tools. This enables you to swap out the strap for a different style, easily changing the look. watches.name: Desk Diver - Professional Electric Blue

Having a limited number of cases from over 50 years ago, the Desk Diver sold out quickly. Introducing the Desk Diver - Professional. The professional Desk Diver, though, can dive! Rated to 330 Feet, every professional Desk Diver is pressure tested and regulated. The Professional Desk Diver is designed after the recovered 1970's Swiss made case we found new old stock. We created a new dial and handset for this watch to match the case's 70's look. The watch has been fitted with a Swiss made Sellita SW200-1b automatic movement and a Sapphire crystal matching the shape of the original. We created a Bracelet for the new version with quick release spring bars. The dial, bezel pip, and handset has X1 Superluminova so you can easily see the time in a dark office environment! The "Superlative" Desk Diver for Professionals can now be yours, unofficially certified! What Swiss Brand Made the original case? The inside of the caseback was marked "Aetos SA - Swiss Made." We could not find much out about this brand in our research. This brand was a Swiss case supplier, and that's all we know. We did have fun imagining what the dial and hands might look like since we had no reference to what it did originally. We recovered these cases from a defunct watch parts supplier who had a gross of new old stock watch parts.
